newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY STABLE TO WEAKER.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY STABLE TO WEAKER.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted stable against the U.S. dollar but closed Monday's interbank session slightly easier on sterling, the mark and the rand.
"There wasn't much happening in the market today. Initially we saw pressure on the Zimbabwe dollar but I think traders were just trying to protect their positions," a foreign exchange dealer said.
"The U.S. dollar was also range-bound on the international scene and (as a result) there wasn't much (Zimbabwe dollar) movement against the other currencies," he added.
The local unit closed on Monday at 11.2800/2900 against the U.S. dollar-- where it finished on Friday-- but slipped against sterling to 18.3600/3800 from 18.3210/3490.
It was also weaker at 6.5500/5700 versus the mark from 6.5440/5520 and at 2.5300/5400 on the rand compared to 2.5310/5350.
